subject.title: fix(ui): turn large pasted text into compact composer attachments

question: After the concurrent-paste state-loss bug is fixed, should every plain-text paste over 1000 characters automatically become an attachment in the Control UI?
rationale: The state repair is mechanical, but the unconditional threshold and replacement of native paste behavior are product choices that correctness checks cannot decide.

options.title: Fix and accept default
options.body: Repair current-state merging, retain the 1000-character threshold, and land after exact-head proof and checks.

options.title: Require explicit conversion
options.body: Preserve native paste by default and expose attachment conversion as a user action.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close the PR if automatic long-paste conversion is not desired.

recommendation.title: Fix and accept default
recommendation.body: Repair current-state merging, retain the 1000-character threshold, and land after exact-head proof and checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history owner for composer behavior and the adjacent pasted-image interaction.
